BackstoryDef.title: livestock pen hand
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a runt raised in the human livestock pens. Watching prisoners herded around like cattle must have done something — [PAWN_pronoun] never did learn to think of humans as people.

BackstoryDef.title: raiders' pack-hauler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] early years hauling equipment and plunder behind the raiding parties. Got plenty of front-row seats to the violence. Never got handed a weapon.

BackstoryDef.title: runt of the litter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the weakest of five born in the same litter. Always got shoved to the back. That habit never went away.

BackstoryDef.title: crevice crawler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a narrow mineshaft and dragged into mine work not long after. Spent an entire childhood underground.

BackstoryDef.title: alchemy test subject
BackstoryDef.description: 'KIYAAAH!! STOP!! I HURT!! NO MORE WEIRD LIQUID!!' — [PAWN_nameDef] was a test subject for goblin alchemical experiments. Every foul brew and painful procedure they could think of. On the bright side, [PAWN_pronoun] barely reacts to poison anymore.

BackstoryDef.title: slaughterhouse corner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the corner of the slaughterhouse, playing with severed scraps like toys. The difference between a meal and a plaything never quite formed.

BackstoryDef.title: skin mask thief
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wanted [PAWN_possessive] own skin mask so badly that [PAWN_pronoun] quietly began peeling small strips from the bound prisoners. The patchwork result was hideous. [PAWN_pronoun] wore it with pride.

BackstoryDef.title: ruins scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] scavenged through ruins left over from the Mechanoid Wars, picking through scrap and wreckage. Still has no idea what most of it was for. Still picks it up.

BackstoryDef.title: living shield
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was captured by a Ratkin knight order and strapped to a tower shield as a living meat screen. [PAWN_possessive] surviving kin took out their frustrations on [PAWN_objective] the whole time. [PAWN_pronoun] spent every moment planning revenge.

BackstoryDef.title: in the squad leader's shadow
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] never strayed far from the commander's side, picking up tactics through sheer proximity. Never received a single formal order — and yet the shape of a squad formation comes naturally.

BackstoryDef.title: first kill
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] proved [PAWN_possessive] worth through combat within days of awakening. [PAWN_possessive] opponent from that duel became the evening meal. [PAWN_pronoun] hasn't hesitated since.

BackstoryDef.title: shaman's aide
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assisted the priest of the flesh-consuming faith from an early age, learning the doctrine before most goblins had even heard of it. [PAWN_pronoun] was the first to believe — truly believe — that it was possible to become human.

BackstoryDef.title: little caesar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] started bossing other goblins around almost immediately after awakening. Never learned how to give commands — they just came out naturally.

BackstoryDef.title: bone toy craftsman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up playing with toys made from bones. The idea that this might be unusual never occurred to [PAWN_pronoun]. Whoever tried to take those toys became the next set of materials.

BackstoryDef.title: punching bag hobgoblin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up on the receiving end of a stronger littermate's fists. The rage piled up — and since it had nowhere to go, it found its way to the goblins and prisoners lower on the chain.

BackstoryDef.title: late bloomer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s mother had an unusually long gestation. All that extra time spent drinking in nutrients shows — [PAWN_nameDef] came out with a noticeably larger head and a sharper one to match.

BackstoryDef.title: pheromone-sired
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born from a pheromone transfer and has no idea who the father is. No idea who the mother is either, really. Only a faint smell of blood to stand in for a childhood.

BackstoryDef.title: birthway breaker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was different from the start — literally tore through the mother's abdomen on the way out. A pioneer spirit, if you want to put it nicely.

BackstoryDef.title: warg-nursed
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s human mother abandoned [PAWN_objective] in front of a warg den to hide what she'd given birth to. The wargs, drawn by the pheromones, nursed [PAWN_objective] anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: first breath of ash
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born under a toxic atmospheric generator. First breath was a trial. The lungs that survived it made [PAWN_pronoun] what [PAWN_pronoun] is today.

BackstoryDef.title: herder's pup
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up among livestock handlers. The same gestures used to move animals come out automatically when dealing with people.

BackstoryDef.title: fireside tale-listener
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up listening to war stories around the fire. About half of [PAWN_possessive] own stories come from those nights.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin livestock
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] early years chained up in an unruly mob. Even now, [PAWN_pronoun] sometimes reaches down to touch [PAWN_possessive] wrists.

BackstoryDef.title: young husband
BackstoryDef.description: Upon birth, [PAWN_nameDef] immediately tried to crawl back from whence [PAWN_objective] came. Watching this, the other goblins held their bellies and cackled "Kishishit!", while the other prisoners could only watch in sheer horror.

BackstoryDef.title: mousie fire starter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] early years setting fire to Mousie prisoners and watching them run. Standard childhood entertainment.

BackstoryDef.title: sewer pup
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a human settlement. [PAWN_possessive] mother took one look, panicked, dumped [PAWN_nameDef] and [PAWN_possessive] siblings down a sewer drain, and ran. They grew up wild.

BackstoryDef.title: fast newborn
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was sprinting around the room before the umbilical cord was even cut.

BackstoryDef.title: littermate eater
BackstoryDef.description: 'Hungry!! Too bright!! You're loud!!' — [PAWN_nameDef] ate [PAWN_possessive] littermates immediately after birth.

BackstoryDef.title: revenge survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] watched every goblin [PAWN_pronoun] knew get killed in a human extermination raid. [PAWN_possessive] legs were fast enough to lose the pursuers.

BackstoryDef.title: isekai reincarnator(?)
BackstoryDef.description: 'OI, [PAWN_nameDef]!! STOP RAMBLING!! GO SHOVEL THAT DUNG PILE!! IT GOES IN THE STEW!!' — [PAWN_nameDef] has always had a strange air about [PAWN_pronoun]. Talks like a human. Keeps muttering something about an unfamiliar ceiling.

BackstoryDef.title: livestock liberator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] used to secretly cut prisoners loose and let them run. Whether it was twisted sport, or just hunger for fresh meat, nobody was entirely sure.

BackstoryDef.title: scheduled for the pot
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was classified as 'pot-ready' immediately after birth — too small, too weak — and hung up in storage. A fatter prisoner arrived and bumped [PAWN_nameDef]'s slot. Then everyone forgot.

BackstoryDef.title: tagged meat
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was branded as livestock-grade material and marked accordingly. The scars never faded.

BackstoryDef.title: escaped sacrifice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was on the ritual altar, about to be consumed, when an outside raid disrupted the ceremony. Lucky doesn't quite cover it.

BackstoryDef.title: escaped course dish
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] watched [PAWN_possessive] siblings get eaten piece by piece. Got out before [PAWN_possessive] own turn came.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin food stock
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] watched [PAWN_possessive] siblings go straight from birth into a boiling cauldron. Ran. Didn't stop.

BackstoryDef.title: mother-eater
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handled the first meal personally — the mother died mid-birth from goblin postpartum syndrome, and [PAWN_nameDef] helped [PAWN_pronoun]self. Whether that was love or hunger is a question [PAWN_pronoun] has never thought to ask.

BackstoryDef.title: waste pit birth
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was thrown into the waste pit as a prank the day [PAWN_pronoun] was born. Fed on filth, beaten back down every time [PAWN_pronoun] tried to climb out. The goblins thought it was hilarious. [PAWN_nameDef] spent all of it planning what comes next.

BackstoryDef.title: punching bag slave
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the runt the others practiced on for fun. Got used to being hit. Never did figure out what [PAWN_pronoun] did to deserve it.

BackstoryDef.title: the tickler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] used to poke at the human prisoners with iron skewers and call it 'tickling.' Couldn't understand why they laughed and cried at the same time. Found it fascinating.

BackstoryDef.title: offal barrel scrubber
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] early years scrubbing out the offal barrels in the slaughterhouse. The smell never left. [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't notice it anymore.

BackstoryDef.title: burn-scarred apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] apprenticed beside a forge fire, collecting burns along the way. The scarred hands are the only record of those years.

BackstoryDef.title: silence vow (joke)
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] barely speaks anymore. The bosses threatened to sew [PAWN_possessive] mouth shut if [PAWN_pronoun] didn't shut up. It was probably a joke. [PAWN_nameDef] took it literally and never recovered.

BackstoryDef.title: leech valley survivor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was abandoned in a swamp and covered in leeches and parasites for what felt like forever. Survived. Doesn't flinch when things crawl on [PAWN_pronoun] anymore.

BackstoryDef.title: coward raider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has played dead in the middle of combat more than once. Knows it's cowardly. Is proud of it anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: the snitch
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] used to report on prisoners' every move to the guards — sometimes accurately, sometimes not. Getting a prisoner beaten on a false tip and listening to the screams was [PAWN_possessive] favorite part of the day.

BackstoryDef.title: pet maggot keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept maggots from a corpse as pets and gave them names. They grew up and flew away. [PAWN_pronoun] was heartbroken.

BackstoryDef.title: skin mask fitting model
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was called in every time a new skin mask needed fitting. Takes a strange pride in being the template.

BackstoryDef.title: bone dice stakes
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was staked in a bone-dice game and won by the side that refused to take [PAWN_objective]. Has been unable to look at bone dice since.

BackstoryDef.title: skull collector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] collected rat skulls and considered [PAWN_pronoun]self a scholar. The count was the measure of intelligence — more skulls, smarter goblin. Also takes Mousie skulls, apparently.

BackstoryDef.title: damp cave explorer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in a cave and helped dig them ever since. Doesn't feel at home unless it smells like wet rock.

BackstoryDef.title: goat milk sucker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] used to chase down goats in the field and drink their milk directly. Was fairly well known among the goats for this.

BackstoryDef.title: young attacker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was regularly drafted into raids on nearby goblin settlements and human villages.

BackstoryDef.title: skull tower builder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] used to stack severed goblin and human heads into towers for fun.

BackstoryDef.title: stone scribbler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] covered stone slabs in marks and drawings. Everyone called it scribbling. It was actually a private record-keeping system only [PAWN_pronoun] could read.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin prodigy
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was talking and counting before the others. Got both admiration and a lot of shoves for it.

BackstoryDef.title: cried once never again
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] cried exactly once after being born, then never again. Has been considered the 'tough one' ever since.

BackstoryDef.title: woke up by the pot
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came to [PAWN_possessive] senses already tied up next to a cauldron. A fatter prisoner went in first, which is the only reason [PAWN_pronoun] is here. Freezes up at the sound of boiling water.

BackstoryDef.title: shaft digger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works the deepest part of the shaft — the spots that look like solid rock to everyone else. Has spent more time underground than above it. In open daylight, [PAWN_pronoun] can barely keep [PAWN_possessive] eyes open.

BackstoryDef.title: human livestock keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] manages the human livestock. Never learned to see them as anything else.

BackstoryDef.title: cauldron keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the cauldrons and the butchering block. Nobody in the squad comes close on knife work.

BackstoryDef.title: pack hauler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hauls supplies and plunder in a skin-leather pack. Gets calmer the heavier the load.

BackstoryDef.title: pheromone signal runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carries tactical information through pheromone signals when ash clouds cut visibility. Gets the message across more accurately than words.

BackstoryDef.title: breeding store cleaner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] maintains the breeding facility tools with obsessive care. Has never once been selected for pheromone extraction. [PAWN_pronoun] is, however, the most skilled handler in the squad.

BackstoryDef.title: human butcher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles butchering as a dedicated role. Whether the subject is still breathing or not doesn't factor into the work.

BackstoryDef.title: humming butcher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hums while doing a full human breakdown. To [PAWN_pronoun], it's just background music.

BackstoryDef.title: torture chamber hand
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles cell cleanup and beating assistance. [PAWN_pronoun] genuinely isn't sure which one is the main job.

BackstoryDef.title: lame pack hauler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] injured [PAWN_possessive] leg young and has hauled cargo ever since. Can't move fast. Won't put the load down.

BackstoryDef.title: beacon ash hauler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] assists with beacon ignition. Permanently soaked in smoke. The cough hasn't gone away.

BackstoryDef.title: crevice obsessive
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has an intense fixation on narrow, damp crevices. Digs into them compulsively. Never cleans up afterward.

BackstoryDef.title: slave market merchant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] works the black markets and trading caravans, moving slaves. Doesn't lose a negotiation.

BackstoryDef.title: pheromone harvester
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] specializes in pheromone extraction — the backbone of the breeding system.

BackstoryDef.title: weapons overseer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] runs the forge and oversees weapon production. If [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't like what came out, the smith starts over.

BackstoryDef.title: will-breaking enforcer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles the dedicated will-breaking detail. No hesitation. Efficient.

BackstoryDef.title: beacon keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] manages the goblin signal beacons and handles raid call-outs.

BackstoryDef.title: warchief candidate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has ambitions that span more than one squad.

BackstoryDef.title: bride hunter
BackstoryDef.description: The most feared name whispered in the villages. [PAWN_nameDef] lines up the women taken in a raid and calls out assessments — teeth, build, bearing — out loud, one by one. When [PAWN_pronoun] points, that one doesn't stand in line again. Every survivor who made it back says the same thing: the expression never changed.

BackstoryDef.title: torture artisan
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] considers interrogation and torture to be close to an art form. Won't accept a result [PAWN_pronoun] isn't satisfied with. Starts over.

BackstoryDef.title: human flesh gourmet
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has detailed opinions on every cut and preparation method. The listener is always uncomfortable. [PAWN_pronoun] is always sincere.

BackstoryDef.title: deserter retriever
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rounds up scattered feral goblins and folds them into the squad.

BackstoryDef.title: drugged deputy
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is soaked in sticky fluid and has trembling hands. Still holds the deputy position.

BackstoryDef.title: human leather tailor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles leather processing full-time. Precise work.

BackstoryDef.title: bone powder apothecary
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grinds bones into powder and compounds it into medicines.

BackstoryDef.title: beacon ceremony dancer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] performs at the ignition ceremony. The prisoners in attendance have described the dance as 'disturbing.'

BackstoryDef.title: goblin deserter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was expelled from another mob and drifted until landing here.

BackstoryDef.title: addled laborer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] does manual labor in a state of constant sticky-fluid addiction.

BackstoryDef.title: human mimic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] imitates humans and gets mocked for it by [PAWN_possessive] own kind. Hasn't stopped.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin livestock trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] specialized in conditioning captured prisoners into compliant livestock and selling them on. To [PAWN_nameDef], humans are useful animals. Nothing more.

BackstoryDef.title: slave pit manager
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed the holding pit and ran down escapees. Humans, goblins, Mousies, Vixens — all mixed in waiting for the end. [PAWN_nameDef]'s favorite part was listening to the crying, and watching the fights that broke out inside.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin pirate crew
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] raided fishing villages and merchant ships up and down the coast. Claims to have found legendary treasure once. Ate it because [PAWN_pronoun] was hungry.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] combines urine, ground bone, and deep-earth mineral dust and calls it alchemy. It's chemistry. The goblin black powder [PAWN_pronoun] produces is genuinely good.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin field engineer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] builds field barricades and traps on the fly in the middle of a fight.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin head cook
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles the high-end cooking. Considers [PAWN_pronoun]self a step above the cauldron crew. The cauldron crew has opinions about this.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin stealth scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handles night reconnaissance and ambush scouting.

BackstoryDef.title: nutcracker master
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] developed [PAWN_possessive] own fighting style: the 'Nutcracker.' Particularly effective against male combatants. There is also a related technique called the 'Nutbite.' Neither is taught at any school.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin blade
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wields a blade so skillfully that [PAWN_pronoun] might as well be considered one with it. Once, when captured by humans and facing execution, [PAWN_pronoun] swung a broken blade, cutting down all the guards and casually making [PAWN_possessive] escape. "This chilly yet heavy sensation! Hoouman! I shall strip the flesh from your bones!"

BackstoryDef.title: golden goblin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was tasked with manufacturing goblin alloys in the forge, but one day got into an argument with another goblin while working. Enraged, [PAWN_nameDef] poured the molten gold meant for the alloy over the rival goblin's head. Watching this, the other goblins cackled "Kishishit!" and gave [PAWN_nameDef] the nickname 'Golden Goblin', joking that [PAWN_pronoun] had created a goblin made of gold.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin caravan member
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a member of a goblin caravan. However, whenever negotiations failed, the caravan would almost always turn from traders into raiders.

BackstoryDef.title: finger collector
BackstoryDef.description: Word among the squad is that [PAWN_nameDef] has the exact count of every enemy finger memorized. On nights when the tally drops, [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't sleep.

BackstoryDef.title: human flower arranger
BackstoryDef.description: A slave who saw the aftermath described it — branches stuffed into every wound, spread out like a garden bed from a distance. [PAWN_nameDef] thought it looked genuinely beautiful.

BackstoryDef.title: human gardener
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] trims. Everything that protrudes. Meticulously.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin sister (peanut version)
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] loved mimicking 'Peanut,' a Mousie nun who thought [PAWN_pronoun] could be reformed. Peanut met a noisy end — stripped alive. Her hide is still with the goblin she believed in. [PAWN_nameDef] is delighted about this. 'SQUEAKERS CAN BE NUNS!! GOBLINS CAN TOO!! I ALSO SERVE THE HAMSTER LORD!!'

BackstoryDef.title: vixen tail-pull champion
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the reigning champion of the Vixen tail-cutting contest. 'FLUFFY!! FEELS GOOD!! YIPPERS CAN CRY ALL THEY WANT!!'

BackstoryDef.title: slender fingers
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has thin fingers and knows exactly where to press inside a prisoner's body to get the response [PAWN_pronoun] wants. The same hands produce unusually precise craft work for a goblin.

BackstoryDef.title: eyeball necklace artisan
BackstoryDef.description: A trader who saw the necklace up close said [PAWN_pronoun] thought it was gemstones at first. Finding out what it actually was is the moment [PAWN_pronoun] regrets most.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin musician
BackstoryDef.description: 'LISTEN!! THIS IS MUSIC!! EACH ONE MAKES A DIFFERENT SOUND, HIGH ONES, LOW ONES!! EAT THEM ALL TOGETHER AND YOU GET A CHORUS!! YOU TRY A VERSE!!' Cooking ruins the pitch. [PAWN_nameDef] eats everything raw.

BackstoryDef.title: vixen hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is obsessed with Vixen tails. Specifically with watching Vixens scramble and yip as they run. [PAWN_pronoun] always aims away from the vitals and lets them go. Then follows.

BackstoryDef.title: tail blanch connoisseur
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] prefers tail meat — Mousie or Vixen, blanched alive, sliced fresh. The struggling and screaming, [PAWN_pronoun] will tell you, really does improve the appetite.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin waddler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] earned that nickname from the walk.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin lemonade maker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] earned that nickname in combat. Still does.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin coward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is in the bushes the moment the signal sounds. Gets dragged out by the collar every time. Screams 'I SAID I'M NOT FIGHTING!!' the whole way. Still swings when it comes to it. Somehow has the best survival rate in the squad.

BackstoryDef.title: scared of own shadow
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] attacks [PAWN_possessive] own shadow on sight due to pheromone hallucinations. Every time.

BackstoryDef.title: kidney stone collector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] saves the kidney stones and bladder stones found while butchering. Keeps them somewhere private.

BackstoryDef.title: skin knitter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned knitting from an old prisoner, but uses strips of skin taken from the living instead of thread.

BackstoryDef.title: tooth hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] pulls teeth from living subjects, one at a time, counting as [PAWN_pronoun] goes. Marks the hundredth quietly.

BackstoryDef.title: scream identifier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] can identify which body part a scream is coming from just by the sound. Gets genuinely annoyed when [PAWN_pronoun] guesses wrong.

BackstoryDef.title: mirror player
BackstoryDef.description: A barely escaped prisoner reported the worst part wasn't the cutting — it was seeing it in the polished shield [PAWN_nameDef] held up. [PAWN_nameDef] seemed to think showing them was a kindness.

BackstoryDef.title: puppeteer
BackstoryDef.description: A prisoner who survived the camp and made it out described it: every morning [PAWN_nameDef] greets the dolls. When a new one appears overnight in a dead person's spot, [PAWN_pronoun] picks right back up mid-conversation. If one doesn't answer, [PAWN_pronoun] gets genuinely angry.

BackstoryDef.title: leech farmer
BackstoryDef.description: Every prisoner released from there had leech marks all over. [PAWN_nameDef] called it a harvest and bragged about it the way a farmer brags about a good crop.

BackstoryDef.title: gut-rope acrobat
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] performs acrobatics on a line made from dried intestine. When it snaps, [PAWN_pronoun] gets annoyed — not about the source material, just that the line broke. The prisoner count in the holding pit always drops on those days.

BackstoryDef.title: nail groomer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] offers to 'tidy up' nails with pliers. Removes them completely. Every time.

BackstoryDef.title: false comforter
BackstoryDef.description: A prisoner at the end of an execution line recounted it afterward: [PAWN_nameDef] held [PAWN_possessive] hand, patted [PAWN_possessive] shoulder, whispered that it would be fine, that it would be quick, that it wouldn't hurt. The prisoner relaxed. The thing [PAWN_nameDef] was holding wasn't a remedy.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin quack
BackstoryDef.description: 'ITS FINE ITS FINE!! I AM DOCTOR!! REAL DOCTOR!! LOOK, HANDS NOT SHAKING... HEY WHY YOU SCREAMING I JUST CUT YOU. THIS IS MEDICINE!! COME BACK NEXT TIME I CUT MORE BETTER!!'

BackstoryDef.title: scream jar collector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] believes [PAWN_pronoun] is trapping prisoner screams in jars. Labels each one.

BackstoryDef.title: beastfolk wall builder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has a technique for using small-framed Mousies and Vixens as structural elements — inserted alive with just enough exposed to stay functional, mortared in when they stop. Goblins don't notice the smell.

BackstoryDef.title: tail collector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] collects the protruding parts — tails are the favorite. Takes them very slowly from Vixens, Mousies, and Itakin prisoners, listening the whole time. Then ties the cut piece around the original owner's neck as a gift. Sweet, in a way.

BackstoryDef.title: hide stripper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] strips hides from prisoners and corpses. Doesn't check which one first.

BackstoryDef.title: shadow duelist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has considered [PAWN_possessive] own shadow a lifelong rival. Challenges it daily.

BackstoryDef.title: nonsense prophet
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] says things that mean nothing. Some of them turn out to be right. [PAWN_pronoun] now has followers.

BackstoryDef.title: bone domino champion
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s only hobby is setting up bone domino runs. Surprisingly precise.

BackstoryDef.title: comrade lover
BackstoryDef.description: When females were absent, [PAWN_nameDef] became the object of comradely love for other comrades. It was awkward in the beginning, but now [PAWN_nameDef] has been reborn as a true lover of comradely love, sharing it with full vigor. Lai Lai Cha Cha Cha! Hey! Ppa Ppa Ri Ppa!

BackstoryDef.title: goblin tooth-puller
BackstoryDef.description: 'OPEN UP!! PULLING THE CAVITY!! ...WAIT THIS ONE IS WHITE, NOT A CAVITY? DOESN'T MATTER, ALREADY OUT!! NEXT TOOTH!!'

BackstoryDef.title: goblin barber
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] trims hair. Along with the scalp.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin midwife
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] arrives with a knife to 'help' with childbirth. Has never actually helped.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin animal doctor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] treats prisoners instead of livestock. Extracts teeth without anesthetic as 'preventive care.'

BackstoryDef.title: goblin gatekeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hangs prisoners from their limbs one at a time for 'security.' Is the most dangerous thing in the vicinity. Nobody has told [PAWN_pronoun].

BackstoryDef.title: goblin messenger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] delivers prisoner body parts to other tribes as formal messages. Brands them delivered.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin ledger keeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] logs prisoner flesh by cut and weight in a ledger. Calls it inventory management.

BackstoryDef.title: sweet dreams friend
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] puts people to sleep with a club and considers it a kindness. 'HUMAN KEEP CRYING SO I PUT THEM SLEEP!! REST WELL FRIEND!!'

BackstoryDef.title: goblin tattoo artist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] uses skin as a canvas and prisoners as the subject. Works while they're still breathing.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin scribe
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carves raid tallies and tribal rules into leather and stone. The only member of the mob considered to 'read and write.'

BackstoryDef.title: goblin stonemason
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has a gift for mixing bone and stone into walls and totems. [PAWN_pronoun] believes the earth spirits lend [PAWN_possessive] hands. It's a genetic trait.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin corpse sculptor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designs structural arrangements using human remains. Not compulsion — the technique and aesthetic judgment are genuinely there.

BackstoryDef.title: star navigator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] can navigate by star charts even through ash cloud cover. The tribe's pathfinder.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin casanova
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has an unusual capacity for reading the state of mind of female prisoners. Applied primarily to reduce resistance in bride negotiations and slave bonding.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin con artist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has lured many enemies out of cover with a promise of mercy. Breaks the promise every time.

BackstoryDef.title: professional bait
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the decoy — deliberately exposed while playing weak to draw enemies into the kill zone. Rotates out frequently.
eng_title:

BackstoryDef.title: goblin quickfeet
BackstoryDef.description: The whole squad will tell you the same thing — [PAWN_nameDef] had [PAWN_possessive] back turned before they even saw the enemy. Nobody has ever caught [PAWN_pronoun]. Nobody's seen [PAWN_pronoun] fight either.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin courier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carries orders and signals between squads. Makes it through ash clouds without getting lost. Always first to arrive.

BackstoryDef.title: head football champ
BackstoryDef.description: 'HEY!! LOOK!! I AM VERY GOOD AT HEAD FOOTBALL!! SWOOSH — GOAL!! YOU WANT TO TRY?? JUST LEND ME ONE HEAD!!'

BackstoryDef.title: arson raider
BackstoryDef.description: Every survivor of every raided village reports the same thing — [PAWN_nameDef] set fire to things before anyone touched the loot. [PAWN_possessive] own squadmates complain constantly. [PAWN_pronoun] has no idea why.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin trench digger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] digs field trenches ahead of the raiding party. Support role. Rarely sees direct fighting.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] moves fast, locates the enemy, reports back. Avoids anything that requires close combat.

BackstoryDef.title: sausage collector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a light skirmisher — short blade, minimal armor, run in low and disrupt the formation from the groin up. Nobody really liked having [PAWN_pronoun] on the same side either.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin camel rider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] raided desert trade routes from camel-back, bow and firearm both. Hit merchant convoys across open sand.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin warg rider
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rode a warg, swinging a curved blade and throwing a lasso. That's the whole job description.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin herald
BackstoryDef.description: The standard for a mounted herald is someone imposing and handsome. [PAWN_nameDef] got the role anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: virgin plunderer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] participates in pillaging for one reason only: to hunt virgins. Everything else is completely irrelevant. Using a freakishly sharp sense of smell, [PAWN_pronoun] never fails to track down virgins.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin entrail addict
BackstoryDef.description: 'FRESH GUTS!! GUTS GUTS GUTS!! WARM ONES ONLY, CHEWING IS DIFFERENT!! MY HANDS ARE SHAKING... MORE!! MORE MORE MORE!! I CANNOT WORK WITHOUT THEM!!'

BackstoryDef.title: gut scarf fashionista
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wears fresh intestines as a scarf. The smell intensifies in warm weather. [PAWN_pronoun] considers it perfume.

BackstoryDef.title: vintage wine connoisseur
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] developed a preference for older female prisoners after a particular experience. Other goblins call it the henhouse instinct. [PAWN_nameDef] calls them 'wine' and treats them with what [PAWN_pronoun] considers respect. Still goes on raids specifically to find one.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin humper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] possesses an absurdly higher stamina and impulse than other goblins. In fact, [PAWN_pronoun] can easily be found by simply following the trail of heavy goblin panting, moans, the wet slapping sound of flesh, and the disgusting stench of chestnut blossoms.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin feminist activist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] found a book about feminism during a raid on a human settlement and became fascinated by it. [PAWN_pronoun] now champions women's rights, preaching that all men must be crushed. Paradoxically, [PAWN_pronoun] hasn't yet processed the minor detail that [PAWN_pronoun] is, in fact, a male.

BackstoryDef.title: bites to decide
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] bites first whenever there's a dispute. First to step forward when the squad hierarchy gets unclear.

BackstoryDef.title: mechanoid war veteran
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carries traces of advanced military conditioning from the Mechanoid War era. The precision stands out sharply against [PAWN_possessive] own kind.

BackstoryDef.title: twisted human aspirant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has mutilated [PAWN_possessive] own body trying to look more human. Seems satisfied every time [PAWN_pronoun] checks the mirror.

BackstoryDef.title: breeding stud
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a diligent goblin whose exceptional stamina allowed endless work without rest. The air around [PAWN_nameDef] always reeked of sour sweat and a heavy, musky scent.

BackstoryDef.title: half-goblin
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a rare being who was sired by a goblin father but is not a goblin. Nevertheless, goblin blood undoubtedly runs through [PAWN_pronoun]'s veins.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin livestock
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was captured by goblins and spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood as a prisoner. In a horrific environment where [PAWN_pronoun] never knew when [PAWN_pronoun] might be eaten, [PAWN_nameDef] lost both [PAWN_possessive] words and vitality.

BackstoryDef.title: saved soul
BackstoryDef.description: During [PAWN_possessive] childhood, [PAWN_nameDef] lost [PAWN_possessive] parents right before [PAWN_possessive] eyes and witnessed their corpses being brutally butchered by goblins. Just moments before [PAWN_pronoun] too was about to become an ingredient for a goblin dish, [PAWN_pronoun] was narrowly rescued by goblin hunters. [PAWN_pronoun] vowed to one day exterminate every last goblin.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin's plaything
BackstoryDef.description: During [PAWN_possessive] childhood, [PAWN_nameDef] managed to escape a gruesome fate by catching the fancy of an eccentric goblin—whether by luck or misfortune. Though [PAWN_pronoun] survived by serving the eccentric goblin, [PAWN_pronoun] was branded as a traitor by the other prisoners.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin punitive soldier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lost family to goblins and joined a punitive force for revenge. [PAWN_pronoun] will do anything to make goblins pay.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin subjugator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lost [PAWN_possessive] family to goblins. Burning with a desire for revenge, [PAWN_pronoun] volunteered for the subjugation squad. Holding infinite hostility towards goblins, [PAWN_pronoun] is ready to do whatever it takes to avenge [PAWN_possessive] family.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin hunter
BackstoryDef.description: Despising goblins, [PAWN_nameDef] decided to punish them with [PAWN_possessive] own hands. [PAWN_pronoun] honed [PAWN_possessive] skills to specialize in hunting goblins, making a living by rescuing prisoners captured by them and selling goblin trophies.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin subjugation captain
BackstoryDef.description: Recognized for [PAWN_possessive] outstanding leadership and combat abilities, [PAWN_nameDef] was appointed as the captain of the goblin subjugation squad. Under [PAWN_possessive] command, [PAWN_pronoun] defeated countless goblins and saved numerous lives.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin slayer
BackstoryDef.description: At some point, [PAWN_nameDef] began hearing auditory hallucinations. A voice claiming that [PAWN_pronoun] must lead the goblin extermination in its stead revealed the location of a crashed ancient spacecraft to [PAWN_nameDef]. Upon arriving at the designated spot, [PAWN_pronoun] indeed found a spacecraft, and within its wreckage, [PAWN_pronoun] discovered a serum containing mysterious mechanite particles. Despite [PAWN_possessive] suspicions, [PAWN_nameDef] injected the serum into [PAWN_objective]self as the voice commanded, feeling an immense power surge through [PAWN_possessive] body. [PAWN_pronoun] came to trust the voice and, following its will, became a legend known as the 'Goblin Slayer', slaughtering every goblin in sight. [PAWN_pronoun] is now a figure of absolute terror to goblins, and a true symbol of heroism to the inhabitants of the rimworld.

BackstoryDef.title: goblin vending machine
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was unfortunately captured by goblins and reduced to a state of producing babies for them. With each birth, [PAWN_pronoun] felt the life force draining from [PAWN_possessive] body, falling into deep despair. Fortunately, a goblin subjugation squad discovered [PAWN_objective] and rescued [PAWN_objective] from that horrific reality.
